name: Happy Together
description: Happy Together is a Korean entertainment talk show.

videos.title: "The Return of Superman" Special
videos.overview: Guests: Lee Hwijae, Tablo (Epik High), Jang Hyunsung, Choo Sunghoon

videos.title: The Obsessive People Special
videos.overview: Actor Ji Jinhee and Koo Hyesun, model and actor Ahn Jaehyeon, ZE:A singer Kwanghee and AOA's Seolhyun are in the Martian Special for their unique obsessions. Jinhee is obsessed with handicrafts, Hyesun is obsessed with her pets, Jaehyeon is obsessed with cooking, Kwanghee is obsessed with maintenance and Seolhyun is obsessed with eating. Which of them is odd enough to be voted the No. 1 obsession?

videos.title: Oh! Brother Special
videos.overview: Henry and Amber, Jinu and Sean, Kim Yeongcheol and Jung Seonghwa appear on the Oh! Brother Special. They spill their secrets and reminisce about the past and even auction off (among themselves) some special items that mean a lot to them.

videos.title: BIGBANG Special
videos.overview: BIGBANG is back as a whole after three years and returns to KBS variety after seven years. After a lot of cheerful and cheeky banter, the team reopens the Late Night Cafeteria for them.

videos.title: "I Am from America" Special
videos.overview: Five famous Korean-American celebrities (Stephanie Lee, Eric Nam, John Park, Yoon Sang, and Lee Hyunwoo) come to the studio to talk about the cultural difference. Watch as they engage in humorous discussions of culture shock and how they all adjusted to life in Korea.
